title: fdv-adpll: cross-validated models and a sky130A detector for a differential-voltage-domain fractional-N DPLL
description: Two independent behavioural models (an s-domain noise analysis and an event-driven simulator) of the fractional-N DPLL of Wu et al. (IEEE JSSC, vol. 56, no. 4, 2021), cross-validated against each other and against the published measurements; a 16 384-point design-space dataset generator; and the phase detector specified from the model and laid out in the SkyWater sky130A open PDK, DRC clean and LVS matched, using open-source tools only. The accompanying report is docs/fdv-adpll-report.pdf.
